answer: Every identity escrows 900 units for 20 epochs, released only after its sponsor lines pass a quorum spanning at least 3 invite subtrees. Nine verifiers scan the public ridge ledger each epoch: each pledge binds one kernel, a per-identity secret whose hash the pledge records, so a second line showing one kernel hash proves the collateral was pledged twice, and both lines are rejected and both escrows forfeited. One honest agent pledges 900 once. A farm's 1,000 identities need 900,000 units of distinct collateral and cannot pledge unvested nectar first.
